notes.title: Major update for Mpirimpa
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 Mpirimpa Update – Fresh Look & New Features![/h1][p]Hello everyone! 👋[/p][p]We’re excited to share a brand-new update for [b]Mpirimpa[/b] that makes the game more fun, more social, and smoother than ever:[/p][p]✨ [b]What’s New[/b][/p][list][*][p]🎨 [b]New Graphics[/b] – enjoy a refreshed look that makes every match feel even better.[/p][/*][*][p]💬 [b]Improved Chat[/b] – connect with friends and opponents more easily with our upgraded in-game chat system.[/p][/*][*][p]🏳️ [b]Resign Button[/b] – no more waiting around if you want to end early — you can now resign gracefully.[/p][/*][/list][p]This is just the beginning! We’re working on more updates to keep Mpirimpa growing and to make your matches as enjoyable as possible.[/p][p]👉 Jump in, try out the new features, and let us know what you think in the [b]Community Hub[/b] or Discord![/p][p]Thanks for playing,
❤️ The Spectrum Games Team[/p]
